verdict.rationale: Bench's only natural-language surface is the AI Categorization Assistant: you describe a transaction's purpose and it suggests a category in real time. That is a narrow, single-task use of natural language, not general operation of the product. In-app messaging goes to human bookkeepers, not an AI agent, so it does not count as natural-language command of the product. Missing for 10: a general natural-language assistant for reports, banking, tax status or navigation; any agent or chat interface beyond categorization; independent or hands-on corroboration.
